name: Unrin'in Rin
source:
Born in 2005. Third year at Parthenos.
Head of the calligraphy club. She got involved in a quarrel between reformists and conservatives, and has to win a calligraphy competition before graduating, but because the opponent is too strong, she couldn't write a single page and fell asleep, sobbing.
